neucler.intro: Let me show you Neucler, one of Aminul's most complex full-stack web applications.
points: Neucler is a SaaS platform designed for managing and visualizing complex nuclear reactor data.
It features a high-performance interactive dashboard built with Next.js and Three.js.
The backend uses a scalable microservices architecture to process real-time sensor streams.
neucler.outro: It really showcases his ability to combine heavy data processing with stunning 3D data visualization.

faeth.intro: Here is Faeth, an incredible e-commerce experience Aminul built.
points: Faeth is a boutique fashion brand website focused on fluid animations and premium typography.
It leverages Framer Motion and GSAP to create a seamless, app-like navigation experience.
The shopping cart and checkout flow are fully custom and optimized for conversion.
faeth.outro: It's a great example of how he brings high-end brand aesthetics to life on the web.

ciselle.intro: This is Ciselle, a beautiful interactive storytelling platform.
points: Ciselle was built to help authors publish interactive, branching narratives.
The interface uses custom WebGL shaders to create immersive background transitions that react to the story.
It includes a rich text editor built from scratch with collaborative editing features.
ciselle.outro: The focus here was really on creating an emotional connection through design and technology.
